docRequirement: output-styles.md:55 binds the project tier to a NESTED set of directories, not one: "Project output styles load from every `.claude/output-styles/` between the working directory and the repository root." and, as of v2.1.178, "when more than one of these nested directories defines a style with the same name, Claude Code uses the one closest to the working directory." The surrounding <Step> (:49-53) lists the three levels: user `~/.claude/output-styles`, project `.claude/output-styles`, managed policy.
current: `outputStyleDirectories` (packages/shared/src/prompts/output-styles.ts:210-232) pushes exactly three paths and never loops: the user directory `<CONFIG_DIR>/output-styles` (:221, constant at :17), `<workspaceRootPath>/.nessy-agent/output-styles` (:223-225 — the Nessy workspace directory `APP_ROOT/workspaces/{id}`, see prompts/system.ts:671, not a repository), and `<workingDirectory>/.nessy-agent/output-styles` gated on `options.projectTrusted === true` (:227-229). `OUTPUT_STYLES_DIR` is `join(NESSY_AGENT_PROJECT_DIR, 'output-styles')` (:15). There is no `dirname` climb, no repository-root discovery, and `OutputStyleRoots` (:65-81) has no project-root field, so the module is never told where the walk would stop. Precedence for what we DO read matches the page: `discoverCustomOutputStyles` (:465-508) iterates `outputStyleDirectories(options)` at :468 and `styles.set` overwrites, with the comment at :497-500 stating "Later directories outrank earlier ones" and the working directory pushed last — closest-to-cwd wins. It is the only reader, reached from `listOutputStyles` (:518) and `resolveOutputStyle` (:526) -> `resolveOutputStyleComposition` (:564), which prompts/system.ts:439-445 calls on every non-mini system-prompt build with `{ workspaceRootPath, workingDirectory, projectTrusted }` taken from `getSystemPrompt`'s positional parameters (system.ts:400-412). No other path covers the gap: capabilities/native-sources.ts:1013-1067 enumerates the project tier (`.nessy-agent/skills`, `agents`, `mcp.json`, `hooks.json`, `permissions.json`, `MEMORY.md`, `rules`) with no output-styles entry, even though the same block DOES walk ancestors for `.agents/skills` (:1063) and instruction files (:1074) via `ancestorsUpTo` (:730-742); capabilities/runtime-output-styles.ts covers plugin bundles only. Nesting is real in this product: `updateWorkingDirectory` (packages/shared/src/agent/base-agent.ts:1661-1668) moves the cwd during a session, and the canonical project root exists server-side as `resolved.canonicalPath` (packages/server-core/src/sessions/SessionManager.ts:4029, :15917) — it is simply never passed to the prompt path. Selection is app-global `config.json:outputStyleId` (packages/shared/src/config/storage.ts:2508-2529); the Settings picker RPC passes only `workspaceRootPath` (packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:148-160).
divergence: The precedence RULE and the per-directory read are correct; the SET of project directories is one deep instead of the whole chain. We read the working directory's own `.nessy-agent/output-styles` and stop; the page requires every directory between the working directory and the repository root. Nothing about the collision rule needs changing — root-first push order already yields closest-to-cwd-wins (output-styles.ts:497-500). The missing pieces are (a) an ancestor iteration in `outputStyleDirectories`, and (b) a stop root: `OutputStyleRoots` carries no `projectRoot`, and `getSystemPrompt` never receives one. The `.nessy-agent/output-styles` vs `.claude/output-styles` directory name is a separate registered rename (deviation register row :238) and is NOT part of this delta; the managed-policy level is also a separate row.

change.what: Add `projectRoot?: string` — the canonical, validated active project root, the same field name and meaning as capabilities/resolver.ts:115 and agents/definitions.ts:136. Document that it is the walk's stop boundary and that an absent value means "walk nothing beyond the working directory" (current behaviour), so the option bag stays backward compatible for the ~15 test call sites that omit it.

Replace the single push at :227-229 with an ancestor walk (~15 lines, no new file). When `options.projectTrusted === true && options.workingDirectory?.trim()`: build the chain nearest-first from `resolve(workingDirectory)` up to `resolve(options.projectRoot ?? workingDirectory)`, stopping when `dirname(current) === current`; refuse the whole chain (fall back to the working directory alone) when `relative(root, cwd)` is `..`, starts with `..${sep}`, or is absolute — the containment check `projectAncestors` already performs at workflows/workflow-loader.ts:159-171. Then `.reverse()` and `push(join(dir, OUTPUT_STYLES_DIR))` for each, so the root lands first and the working directory last, which is what makes closest-to-cwd win under the existing overwrite rule at :497-500. Keep every walked directory behind the SAME single `projectTrusted === true` gate — the comment at :200-209 records the regression that gate exists for. Add a depth cap constant next to `MAX_OUTPUT_STYLE_BYTES` (:18) so a deep monorepo cannot make one prompt build stat unbounded directories.

Append one optional positional parameter `projectRoot?: string` after `pluginOutputStyles` (:419) and forward it into the `resolveOutputStyleComposition` option bag at :439-445 as `...(projectRoot ? { projectRoot } : {})`. Two lines; the function is already 13 positional parameters, so appending is the only non-breaking shape.

change.symbol: getSystemPrompt call in the turn-shape builder (:1244-1258)
change.what: Pass the session's canonical project root as the new trailing argument. `packages/shared/src/agent/core/types.ts` has no `projectRoot` field today (it carries `workingDirectory` at :57 and `projectTrusted` at :108), so pick one of two: (a) thread the server-resolved `resolved.canonicalPath` into `AgentConfig` as a NON-persisted runtime field and pass it here, or (b) leave the argument undefined and derive the stop root inside output-styles.ts with a `.git`-marker climb copied from `repositoryRoot` (workflows/workflow-loader.ts:149-157). (b) is the smaller change and needs no session-config field; (a) is the more faithful one because the server already validated that path.
Same trailing argument, same source of truth as the Claude call site. Nothing else in the Pi path changes: the composed value stays inside the cacheable system prefix.

Add three cases: (1) a style written at the project root resolves when `workingDirectory` is a nested subdirectory and `projectRoot` is the root; (2) the same style name in root and nested directory resolves to the NESTED file (closest-to-cwd wins); (3) with `projectTrusted` false neither resolves and `## Safety and Engineering` survives — the existing untrusted assertion extended to the walked chain. Keep the existing untrusted case as the negative boundary.

blastRadius: `outputStyleDirectories` has exactly one reader, `discoverCustomOutputStyles` (packages/shared/src/prompts/output-styles.ts:468), which feeds two exported entry points: `listOutputStyles` (:518) — consumed by RPC `settings:listOutputStyles` (packages/server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:148-160, channel packages/shared/src/protocol/channels.ts:238, transport apps/electron/src/transport/channel-map.ts:174, typed at apps/electron/src/shared/types.ts:903, rendered by apps/electron/src/renderer/pages/settings/AiSettingsPage.tsx:685) — and `resolveOutputStyle` (:526) -> `resolveOutputStyleComposition` (:564) -> prompts/system.ts:439, i.e. EVERY system-prompt build on both backends (packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:1245, packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:6604). Changing `getSystemPrompt`'s signature therefore touches both backends. Wire/persistence: the RPC payload shape (`OutputStyleOption`) and the persisted selection (`config.json:outputStyleId`, packages/shared/src/config/storage.ts:2508-2529) are unchanged, and no id format changes — so the base fix crosses NO wire or persistence boundary. It becomes a persistence change, and a risk trigger, only if option (a) adds a `projectRoot` field to session/agent config; deriving the root inside the module avoids that entirely. Prompt-caching boundary: for Pi the system prompt is the cacheable prefix (packages/shared/AGENTS.md), and the composed style value is stable per session, so cache behaviour is unchanged unless the selection now resolves to a different file. Security boundary: the walk reads files that become system-prompt prose, so every walked directory must stay behind `projectTrusted === true` AND inside the project root; the comment at output-styles.ts:200-209 records the exact regression (a repository substituting its own prose for the user's selected style) that the gate was added to stop. Covering tests: packages/shared/src/prompts/__tests__/output-styles.test.ts is the only suite; codegraph reports no other coverage for these three functions.
userImpact: Latent today, and masked by a second gap. A user who keeps a style at their repository root (`<repo>/.nessy-agent/output-styles/careful.md`) and works in a subdirectory — a monorepo package, a nested worktree folder, anywhere `updateWorkingDirectory` (base-agent.ts:1661) has moved the cwd below the root — gets nothing: `resolveOutputStyle` finds no match and `resolveOutputStyleComposition` returns `NO_OUTPUT_STYLE` (output-styles.ts:562), so the prompt is silently unchanged, the engineering guidance stays, and no error, toast or diagnostic appears on any surface. It is not reachable through the UI at all right now because the Settings -> AI output-style picker passes only `workspaceRootPath` (server-core/src/handlers/rpc/settings.ts:148-160), so project-tier styles are never listed and the only way to select one is hand-editing `config.json:outputStyleId` — a separate gap. Fixing that picker without this walk surfaces the bug immediately and confusingly: the style works at the repository root and silently stops working after the user changes the working directory into a package.
